description: This file defines a class 'File' providing utility methods for handling file operations such as verifying existence, resolving real paths, handling temporary directories, and working with ZIP archives within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for file operations in the PhpSpreadsheet library, including handling temporary files, verifying ZIP files, and resolving file paths.

methods.name: setUseUploadTempDirectory
methods.description: Sets a flag to determine whether to use the upload temporary directory for temporary files.

methods.name: getUseUploadTempDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for using the upload temporary directory.

methods.name: validateZipFirst4
methods.description: Validates the first four bytes of a ZIP file to confirm its format.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a given file or ZIP archive member exists.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the canonicalized absolute pathname, including for ZIP archives.

methods.name: sysGetTempDir
methods.description: Retrieves the system temporary directory, optionally using the upload directory if configured.

methods.name: temporaryFilename
methods.description: Creates a temporary filename in the system temp directory.

methods.name: assertFile
methods.description: Asserts that a file exists and is readable; throws exception otherwise.

methods.name: testFileNoThrow
methods.description: Checks file existence and readability, returning boolean, without throwing exceptions.
